[Intro]
[D5]

[Verse 1]
[D5]Broken the pa-
radigm an e-
xample must be set.
[A#5]
[D5]Invoke the Si-
ren's song and sign
the death warrant.
[G#5]
[D5]This is what
has been wrought for
thirty pieces of
silver. [A#5]The
[D5]tongues of men and an-
gels bought by
a beloved betra-
yer. [G#5]

[Chorus]
[F5][G#5]I am the
[F5][G#5]result, what's
[G#5][F5]better left unspo-
[F5][G#5]ken. [F5][G#5]
[D5]Violence
begins to mend
what was
broken.
[F5][G#5]You've been talk-
[F5][G#5]ing,
[F5][G#5]I've been all ears.
[F5]  [G#5]  [F5]  [G#5]

[Verse 2]
[D5]Words meant to dwell
in darkness shall
never see the light
of day. [A#5]Words
[D5]can be broken so
can bones,
execute the man-
date. [G#5]
[D5]Mouth full of dirt
your name is re-
moved from the re-
gistry. [A#5]St.
[D5]Peter greets with
empty eyes then turns
and locks the gate.
[G#5]

[Chorus]
[F5][G#5]I am the
[F5][G#5]result, what's
[G#5][F5]better left unspo-
[F5][G#5]ken. [F5][G#5]
[D5]Violence
begins to mend
what was
broken.
[F5][G#5]You've been talk-
[F5][G#5]ing,
[F5][G#5]I've been all ears.
[F5]  [G#5]  [F5]  [G#5]
[D5]
Omerta.

[Bridge A]
[G#5]  [D5]
[G#5]  [D5]  [A5]  [A#5]
[D5]  [F5]  [F#5]
[G#5]  [D5]

[G#5][D5]Cheaply ve-
nal, stupidly
[G#5][D5]verbose. [A5][A#5]
[D5]  [F5]  [F#5]
[G#5][D5]A slip of the tongue,
a slit of the throat.
[G#5]  [D5]  [A5]  [A#5]
[D5]  [F5]  [F#5]
[G#5][D5]Six feet un-
der with no mar-
[G#5][D5]ker. [A5][A#5]
[D5]  [F5]  [F#5]
[G#5][D5]Keep my name
from your mouth
[G#5][D5][A5][A#5]fore-
[D5][F5]ver. [F#5]

[Bridge B]
[G#5]  [A#5]  [D5]  [F5]  [G#5]  [D5]
[G5]  [D5]

[G5]  [D5]
[G#5][A#5]Free [D5][F5]speech for [G#5]the [D5]li-
[G5]ving, [D5]
[G#5][A#5]dead [D5][F5]men [G#5][D5]
[G5]tell no [D5]tales.
[G#5][A#5]Your [D5][F5]laughing [G#5][D5]fin-
[G5]ger [D5]
[G#5][A#5]will [D5][F5]never [G#5][D5]point
[D5][G5]again.

[Outro]
[D5]
[A#5]O-
[D5]merta.
[G#5]
[D5]
[A#5]O-
[D5]merta.

[D5]now.
